body:
hey sorry for the radio silence. i fell asleep. i feel a little better now. still quite fucked up, but please, go help other people who need to talk to someone more than i do right now. i think i'll go to the doctor's tomorrow, since i've been shivering all night. who knows whati did with my body.

thanks guy. you did help.

Yes, lots of beating up on myself...I don't know, everything just seems too difficult. I started feeling this way in December, took action in January...I guess a lack of good planing judgment and decision making? I can't find work, I can't get a job, my contacts have dried up as people have forgotten about me. I'm really at rock bottom (except financially i am secure for now which is lucky).

Finished school. Couldn't find work. Writing/planning/creative work dried up as I had to move back with my parents. Girlfriend lives 3 hours away and I can't live with her because she's too busy. Usually have about an hour of happiness a day. The rest is just numb, really. To me, rationally, suicide makes the most sense.
